subject: Applicant platform renewal: scope, usage, and cost options
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Applicant platform renewal: scope, usage, and cost options

Hi team,

Our renewals for applicant tracking and background checks are coming up in August (Greenhouse) and September (Checkr). I pulled Q2 usage and a quick cost baseline and attached the TA_tool_usage_Q22026.xlsx. Key things I want us to align on before we engage vendor contracts: 

- True seat/license footprint (active users vs admin-only). Monica, can you confirm active power users vs lurkers?
- Whether we consolidate any of the job-template or sourcing activity into a single license tier to reduce seats.
- Background check scope: current standard is criminal + employment + education for US hires. Do we want to expand to international packages for EMEA/APAC hires this year?
- LMS overlap: we have a separate renewal for the learning platform later in Q4; curious if we should consider cross-vendor discounts.

Requested next steps: each of you please review the attached and reply with: (1) an adjusted seat estimate, (2) any compliance/audit asks I should surface to vendor (e.g., SOC2 artifact cadence), and (3) whether you support pursuing a consolidated renewal (Greenhouse primary + add-on or move to Lever).

I can compile and take the first pass on negotiation points and request an initial quote. If we want a tighter SLA/retention term, let me know.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: TA_tool_usage_Q22026.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applicant platform renewal: scope, usage, and cost options

Thanks Aisha — quick notes after skimming the workbook: 

- Power users (recruiters + hiring managers who create >10 reqs/mo): ~28, still ~3 seats shy of our current purchase tier.
- Admins (reporting/ops): 6. Observers: ~40 (should be viewer seats).
- If we drop 10 observers we can move down one pricing band, but that means losing analytics access for some hiring leads.

Compliance: we do need updated SOC2 Type II evidence annually. Also confirm data retention policy for candidate PII (we currently purge at 24 months but have some long-term candidate pools).

My recommendation: ask for a quote that separates core seats from observer/view-only seats and push for a 12% multi-product discount if we sign Greenhouse + Checkr together (vendors often have bundling options). I'm happy to join the vendor call.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of TA Ops

From: Greenhouse Contracts <contracts@greenhouse.io>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applicant platform renewal: scope, usage, and cost options

Hi Aisha / Monica,

Thanks for the heads up — attached is our initial renewal quote and an option that breaks out core recruiter seats vs viewer seats: Greenhouse_Renewal_Quote_2026-07-02.pdf. Summary: 

- Current list price delta between bands is ~18%; with your current utilization we can offer a 14% renewal discount if you commit to a 12‑month term and add Checkr through our partner bundle.
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide an SSAE report and rolling Type II attestations via our security portal (link included in the PDF).
- International background checks are handled via partner integrations; pricing is variable by country — we can introduce your Checkr rep on the call.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week to walk through the quote and confirmation of seat counts? Proposed times: Tue 7/6 9:30–11:00am PT or Wed 7/7 1:00–3:00pm PT.

Best,
Ellen Vargas
Enterprise Renewals Manager
Greenhouse

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Greenhouse Contracts <contracts@greenhouse.io>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Applicant platform renewal: scope, usage, and cost options

Team — quick consolidation after the vendor quote. Highlights: 

- Greenhouse offered a 14% discount with the partner bundle and can provide SOC2 artifacts on request. Quote attached.
- Seat optimization: Monica's counts suggest we can drop ~8 observer seats and keep all power users; that gets us close to the next lower band, but the effective economics with the 14% discount mean the band move only saves an incremental ~6% net.
- Checkr: vendor contact requested to scope international packages; I'll loop in Checkr next.

Proposal and asks before I schedule the vendor call: 
1) Approve negotiation envelope: target 18% discount, 12-month term, SOC2 evidence delivery within 5 business days post-PO.
2) Approve a one-time cleanup of observer seats (up to 10) to be implemented at contract effective date. This will be coordinated by Monica.
3) Vivek / Lauren: any legal/regulatory asks for retention or retention exceptions? If none, I'll proceed to schedule the call with Greenhouse + Checkr for Wed 7/7 at 1pm PT (tentative).

I attached a quick vendor_comparison_table.pdf and audit_requirements.pdf for reference. If I don't hear objections by EOD Tue, I'll take this as approval and book the call.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_comparison_table.pdf; audit_requirements.pdf
